newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak shares steady, SAX dips 0.09 pts to 166.62.
newsitem.headline: Slovak shares steady, SAX dips 0.09 pts to 166.62.

text.p: Slovak blue chips were steady in thin trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Tuesday, as the SAX dipped 0.09 points to close at 166.62.
Two of the market's leading shares -- steel maker VSZ and oil refinery Slovnaft -- traded relatively high volumes on the bourse floor, though brokers said they did not expect the liquidity to hold.
"It's nice to look at these volumes, but I don't think this will repeat tommorow," said one broker in Bratislava.
VSZ closed unchanged at 630 crowns on a volume of 7,600 shares, while Slovnaft held steady at 830 on 4,689 shares.
The broker added that the current lack of liquidity on the BSE would likely continue over the summer.

Overall, volume increased to 407,369 shares, form 373,492 shares traded on Monday, while turnover eased to 155.86 million crowns, from 174.94 million. Both volume and turnover were boosted by direct trades.
